en.s: The 365 Crete earthquake occurred at about sunrise on 21 July 365 in the Eastern Mediterranean, with an assumed epicentre near Crete. Geologists today estimate the undersea earthquake to have been a moment magnitude 8.5 or higher. It caused widespread destruction in the central and southern Diocese of Macedonia (modern Greece), Africa Proconsularis (northern Libya), Egypt, Cyprus, Sicily, and Hispania (Spain). On Crete, nearly all towns were destroyed.

zh.s: 365年克里特岛地震于公元365年7月21日左右日出时发生，地点在东地中海，推测震中靠近克里特岛。地质学家估计，这场海底地震的矩震级至少为8.5级。地震造成广泛破坏，受灾地区包括马其顿行省中部和南部（今希腊）、阿非利加行省（今利比亚北部）、埃及、塞浦路斯、西西里岛和西班牙。在克里特岛，几乎所有城镇都被摧毁。

en.t: King Berengar I of Italy and a hired Hungarian army defeat the Frankish forces at Verona. King Louis III is captured and blinded for breaking the oath he gave in 902 to not return to Italy
en.s: Berengar I (Latin: Berengarius, Perngarius; Italian: Berengario; c. 845 – 7 April 924) was King of Italy from 887 and Holy Roman Emperor from 915 until his death in 924. He is usually known as Berengar of Friuli, since he ruled the March of Friuli from 874 until at least 890, but he had lost control of the region by 896.

zh.t: 意大利国王贝伦加尔一世与受雇的匈牙利军队在维罗纳击败法兰克军队；因路易三世违背902年发誓不再返回意大利的誓言，他被俘并遭刺瞎双眼
zh.s: 贝伦加尔一世（拉丁语：Berengarius、Perngarius；意大利语：Berengario；约845年—924年4月7日）自887年起担任意大利国王，915年至924年去世期间担任神圣罗马皇帝。他通常被称为弗留利的贝伦加尔，因为他自874年至至少890年统治弗留利边疆区，但到896年时已失去对该地区的控制。

en.s: The Battle of Taillebourg, a major medieval battle fought in July 1242, was the decisive engagement of the Saintonge War. It pitted a French Capetian army under the command of King Louis IX, also known as Saint Louis, and his younger brother Alphonse of Poitiers, against forces led by King Henry III of England, his brother Richard of Cornwall and their stepfather Hugh X of Lusignan.
en.n: Battle of Taillebourg: Louis IX of France puts an end to the revolt of his vassals Henry III of England and Hugh X of Lusignan.

zh.s: 塔耶堡战役是圣通日战争中的一场重要中世纪战役，于1242年7月爆发。交战双方分别是法国卡佩王朝军队和英格兰军队。法军由路易九世（圣路易）及其弟普瓦捷的阿方斯指挥；英军由英格兰国王亨利三世、其弟康沃尔的理查及其继父休十世·德·吕济尼昂率领。
zh.n: 塔耶堡战役：法国国王路易九世平息英格兰国王亨利三世和休十世·德·吕济尼昂这两位封臣发动的叛乱。

en.s: The Battle of Cape St Vincent of 1337 took place on 21 July 1337 between a Castilian fleet commanded by Alfonso Jofre Tenorio and a Portuguese fleet led by the Luso-Genoese admiral Emanuele Pessagno (Manuel Pessanha). The fledgling Portuguese fleet was defeated, bringing a quick end to the brief Luso-Castilian war that begun in 1336.

zh.s: 1337年7月21日，阿方索·霍弗雷·特诺里奥指挥的卡斯蒂利亚舰队，与葡萄牙热那亚裔海军上将埃曼努埃莱·佩萨尼奥（曼努埃尔·佩萨尼亚）率领的葡萄牙舰队在圣文森特角交战。新组建不久的葡萄牙舰队战败，这场战斗很快结束了1336年开始的短暂葡萄牙—卡斯蒂利亚战争。

en.s: The Battle of Épila was fought on July 21, 1348, near Zaragoza, in what is now Spain, between the supporters of the Union of Aragon and King Peter IV, led by Don Lope de Luna. This battle was the culmination of a long confrontation between a large segment of the nobility and the people of Aragon against the king, ending with the decisive defeat of the Union.

zh.s: 1348年7月21日，埃皮拉战役在现今西班牙境内、萨拉戈萨附近爆发，交战双方是阿拉贡联盟的支持者和彼得四世国王的军队，后者由洛佩·德卢纳伯爵率领。这场战役是贵族和阿拉贡民众中相当一部分人与国王长期对抗的高潮，最终阿拉贡联盟遭到决定性击败。

en.s: The Battle of Shrewsbury was a battle fought on 21 July 1403, waged between an army led by the Lancastrian King, Henry IV, and a rebel army led by Henry "Harry Hotspur" Percy from Northumberland. The battle, the first in which English archers fought each other on English soil, demonstrated "the deadliness of the longbow" and ended the Percy challenge to King Henry IV of England. Part of the fighting is believed to have taken place at what is now Battlefield, Shropshire, England, three miles north of the centre of Shrewsbury. It is marked today by Battlefield Church and Battlefield Heritage Park.

zh.s: 什鲁斯伯里战役发生于1403年7月21日，交战双方分别是兰开斯特王朝国王亨利四世率领的军队，以及诺森伯兰的亨利·珀西（“哈里·热刺”）率领的叛军。这是英格兰本土上英格兰弓箭手首次彼此交战的战役，展现了长弓的强大杀伤力，也终结了珀西家族对亨利四世的挑战。据信，部分战斗发生在现今英格兰什罗普郡的巴特尔菲尔德，距什鲁斯伯里市中心以北约3英里。当地现有巴特尔菲尔德教堂和巴特尔菲尔德遗产公园作为纪念。

en.s: The Battle of Modrič (Albanian: Beteja e Modriçit) was an important battle between Skanderbeg's forces and a joint force of Hamza Kastrioti and Tahip Pasha. Skanderbeg gathered 14,000 men and marched against Tahip Pasha's army. Skanderbeg planned to first defeat Hamza and then to move around Tahip and encircle him. Hamza had as many as 12,000 troops. men under his personal command and was camped near the new fortress of Modrič.

zh.s: 莫德里奇战役（阿尔巴尼亚语：Beteja e Modriçit）是斯坎德培部队与哈姆扎·卡斯特里奥蒂、塔希普帕夏联军之间的一场重要战斗。斯坎德培集结14,000人，向塔希普帕夏的军队进军。他计划先击败哈姆扎，再绕到塔希普侧翼包围其部队。哈姆扎亲自指挥的部队最多有12,000人，当时驻扎在新建的莫德里奇要塞附近。

en.s: The Ottoman invasion of Albania in 1452 (Albanian: Fushata shqiptare e Mehmetit II) was a campaign by the newly acceded Ottoman sultan Mehmed II against Skanderbeg, the chief of the League of Lezhë. Shortly after the first siege of Krujë, Murad II died in Edirne, and was succeeded by his son Mehmed II. Mehmed ordered nearly annual invasions of Albania which often resulted in multiple battles in one year.

zh.t: 1452年奥斯曼帝国入侵阿尔巴尼亚
zh.s: 1452年奥斯曼帝国入侵阿尔巴尼亚（阿尔巴尼亚语：Fushata shqiptare e Mehmetit II）是新即位的奥斯曼苏丹穆罕默德二世针对莱什联盟领袖斯坎德培发起的一场军事行动。第一次克鲁亚围城战结束后不久，穆拉德二世在埃迪尔内去世，其子穆罕默德二世继位。此后，穆罕默德几乎每年都下令入侵阿尔巴尼亚，往往一年内就发生多场战斗。

en.t: French invasion of the Isle of Wight
en.s: The French invasion of the Isle of Wight occurred during the Italian Wars in July 1545. The invasion was repulsed. France had a long history of attacking the Isle of Wight, and the 1545 campaign proved to be the last time to date that the French have attempted to take it. Although the French forces, led by Claude d'Annebault, greatly outnumbered those of the English, the battles fought (including the battles of the Solent and Bonchurch) ended without a clear winner. However, as the French were repelled, it could be considered an English victory.

zh.s: 法国于1545年7月在意大利战争期间入侵怀特岛，但遭到击退。法国此前多次袭击怀特岛；1545年的行动是法国迄今最后一次试图夺取该岛。尽管克洛德·达内博率领的法军人数远多于英军，索伦特海战、邦彻奇战役等战斗仍未分出明确胜负。不过，法军最终被击退，因此这场战役也可视为英格兰获胜。

en.s: After the Battle of Heiligerlee, the Dutch rebel leader Louis of Nassau (brother of William the Silent) failed to capture the city of Groningen. Louis was driven away by Fernando Álvarez de Toledo, Duke of Alba and defeated at the Battle of Jemmingen (also known as Battle of Jemgum, at Jemgum in East Frisia, now part of Germany) on 21 July 1568.

zh.s: 海利赫雷战役之后，荷兰叛军领袖路易斯·拿骚（沉默者威廉的弟弟）未能攻占格罗宁根。阿尔瓦公爵费尔南多·阿尔瓦雷斯·德托莱多将他击退，并于1568年7月21日在耶明根战役（又称耶姆贡战役，发生在东弗里西亚的耶姆贡，即今德国境内）中击败他。

en.s: Thomas Cavendish's circumnavigation was a voyage of raid and exploration by English navigator and sailor Thomas Cavendish which took place during the Anglo–Spanish War between 21 July 1586 and 9 September 1588. Following in the footsteps of Francis Drake who circumnavigated the globe, Thomas Cavendish was influenced in an attempt to repeat the feat. As such it was the first deliberately planned voyage of the globe.

zh.t: 托马斯·卡文迪什环球航行
zh.s: 英国航海家托马斯·卡文迪什的环球航行是一次兼具劫掠和探索性质的航程，发生于1586年7月21日至1588年9月9日的英西战争期间。卡文迪什追随弗朗西斯·德雷克环球航行的脚步，尝试重现这一壮举。这是人类首次有计划地环球航行。

en.s: The fourth siege of Breda (21 July – 11 October 1637) was an important siege in the Eighty Years' War in which stadtholder Frederick Henry, Prince of Orange retook the city of Breda, which had last changed hands in 1625 when the Spanish general Ambrogio Spinola conquered it for the Spanish Habsburgs. Hereafter, the city would remain in the hands of the Dutch Republic until the end of the war.

zh.s: 第四次布雷达围城战于1637年7月21日至10月11日进行，是八十年战争中的一场重要围城战。奥兰治亲王、执政腓特烈·亨德里克收复了布雷达。西班牙将领安布罗焦·斯皮诺拉于1625年为西班牙哈布斯堡王朝夺下该城，此后布雷达一直由荷兰共和国控制，直到战争结束。

en.s: The Battle of Cádiz (1640) was a naval battle in the Franco-Spanish War (1635-1659), which took place on July 21, 1640, when a French squadron under Jean Armand de Maillé-Brézé attacked a Spanish convoy coming from the Americas. The attack occurred just in front of the coast of Cádiz.Armand de Breze employed a hitherto unknown tactic to attack the Spanish convoy from both sides. The Spanish lost a galleon and a small vessel but the convoy completed its journey and delivered most of its cargoes including its silver bullion. French losses are unknown.

zh.s: 加的斯海战是1635—1659年法西战争中的一场海战，发生于1640年7月21日。当时，让·阿尔芒·德·马耶-布雷泽率领法国舰队袭击一支从美洲返回的西班牙船队，地点就在加的斯海岸外。布雷泽采用了一种此前未见的战术，从两侧夹击西班牙船队。西班牙损失了一艘大帆船和一艘小船，但船队仍完成航程，运回了大部分货物，包括白银。法国方面的损失不明。

en.s: The Raid on Malaga was a military action by the English against the Spanish city of Málaga on July 21, 1656 as part of the Anglo–Spanish War (1654–1660). Five English ships, HMS Henry, HMS Ruby, HMS Antelope, HMS Greyhound and HMS Bryan, appeared at six in the morning in the Bay of Málaga, without that the Marquis of Mondéjar, governor of the city, raised the alarm. At 13:00 the English frigates approached the harbor and attacked a Genoese and a Sicilian galley. The Sicilian galley succeeded in escaping at the cost of 2 killed and the captain being wounded.

zh.s: 马拉加突袭是英西战争期间英国对西班牙城市马拉加发动的一次军事行动，发生于1656年7月21日。清晨6时，五艘英国舰船“亨利”号、“鲁比”号、“羚羊”号、“灵缇”号和“布莱恩”号出现在马拉加湾，蒙德哈尔侯爵兼该城总督却没有拉响警报。下午1时，英国护卫舰驶近港口，袭击了一艘热那亚桨帆船和一艘西西里桨帆船。西西里船成功逃脱，但有两人死亡，船长受伤。

en.s: The invasion of Martinique in 1674 was an unsuccessful attempt by the Dutch Republic to conquer the Caribbean island of Martinique from France. In spite of overwhelming Dutch superiority in men and ships, the French won a decisive and unexpected victory.

zh.s: 1674年，荷兰共和国试图从法国手中夺取加勒比海岛屿马提尼克，但最终失败。尽管荷兰在兵力和舰船数量上拥有压倒性优势，法国仍取得了出人意料的决定性胜利。

en.s: The Treaty of Passarowitz, or Treaty of Požarevac, was the peace treaty signed in Požarevac (Serbian Cyrillic: Пожаревац, German: Passarowitz, Turkish: Pasarofça), a town that was in the Ottoman Empire but is now in Serbia, on 21 July 1718 between the Ottoman Empire and its adversaries, the Habsburg monarchy and the Republic of Venice.

zh.s: 帕萨罗维茨条约又称波扎雷瓦茨条约，是奥斯曼帝国与哈布斯堡君主国、威尼斯共和国于1718年7月21日签署的和平条约。签署地波扎雷瓦茨（塞尔维亚语西里尔字母：Пожаревац；德语：Passarowitz；土耳其语：Pasarofça）当时属于奥斯曼帝国，如今位于塞尔维亚。

en.s: The Battle of Burkersdorf took place on 21 July 1762 during the Third Silesian War (part of the Seven Years' War). A Prussian army of 23,000 men fought an Austrian army of around 20,000 men. After the death of Elizabeth of Russia, czarina of Russia, her nephew Peter III came to the throne. Peter was a great admirer of Frederick the Great and all things Prussian, and Frederick used this to his advantage.

zh.s: 布克斯多夫战役发生于1762年7月21日，是第三次西里西亚战争（七年战争的一部分）中的一场战斗。普军约23,000人，与约20,000名奥军交战。俄国女皇伊丽莎白去世后，她的侄子彼得三世继位。彼得十分仰慕腓特烈大帝和普鲁士的一切，腓特烈借此占得了优势。

en.s: The Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca Turkish: Küçük Kaynarca Antlaşması (also spelled Kuchuk Kainarjæ) was a peace treaty signed on 21 July 1774, in Küçük Kaynarca (today Kaynardzha, Bulgaria) between the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire. Following the recent Ottoman defeat at the Battle of Kozludzha, the document ended the Russo-Turkish War of 1768–74 and marked a defeat of the Ottomans in their struggle against Russia. The Russians were represented by Field-Marshal Rumyantsev while the Ottoman side was represented by Musul Zade Mehmed Pasha.

zh.s: 《库楚克开纳尔吉条约》（土耳其语：Küçük Kaynarca Antlaşması，也拼作Kuchuk Kainarjæ）是俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国于1774年7月21日在库楚克开纳尔吉签署的和平条约，该地现名卡伊纳尔贾，位于保加利亚。奥斯曼帝国刚在科兹卢贾战役中战败，条约随后结束了1768—1774年的俄土战争，也标志着奥斯曼帝国在与俄罗斯的较量中落败。俄方代表为陆军元帅鲁缅采夫，奥斯曼方代表为穆苏尔·扎德·穆罕默德帕夏。

en.s: The Battle of Bull's Ferry on 20 and 21 July 1780 saw two American brigades under Brigadier General Anthony Wayne attack a party of Loyalist Americans led by Thomas Ward. The Loyalists successfully defended a blockhouse against an ineffective bombardment by four American artillery pieces and a failed attempt to storm the position by Wayne's infantry. During the action, American light dragoons under Major Light Horse Harry Lee drove off a large number of cattle that were kept in the area for the use of the British army in New York City.

zh.s: 布尔斯费里战役发生于1780年7月20日至21日。安东尼·韦恩准将率领两支美国旅，进攻托马斯·沃德领导的一支效忠英国的美国人部队。效忠派成功守住一座碉堡，顶住了四门美国火炮收效甚微的炮击，也挫败了韦恩步兵的强攻。战斗期间，哈里·李少校（“轻骑兵哈里·李”）率领美国轻骑兵赶走了当地大量牛群；这些牛原本供驻纽约市的英军使用。

en.s: The Battle of Colson's Mill was a battle of the American Revolutionary War that took place in North Carolina on July 21, 1780. A Patriot militia under William Lee Davidson scattered a gathering of Loyalists at Colson's Mill, near the junction of the Rocky and Pee Dee Rivers in present-day Stanly County, North Carolina.

zh.s: 科尔森磨坊战役是美国独立战争中的一场战斗，发生于1780年7月21日，地点在北卡罗来纳州。威廉·李·戴维森率领的爱国者民兵在科尔森磨坊击溃了一支效忠派部队。磨坊位于洛基河与皮迪河交汇处附近，也就是如今北卡罗来纳州斯坦利县一带。

en.s: The Battle of Saldanha Bay was a naval action that occurred off the Dutch Cape Colony on 21 July 1781 during the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War. A squadron of Royal Navy warships under the command of commodore George Johnstone captured five Dutch East India Company ships; her own crew destroyed a sixth. Casualties on the Dutch side were minimal if any, and there were no British casualties.

zh.s: 第四次英荷战争期间，1781年7月21日，荷属开普殖民地外海的萨尔达尼亚湾发生海战。乔治·约翰斯通准将率领一支英国皇家海军舰队，俘获了五艘荷兰东印度公司船只；第六艘船则被其船员自行毁坏。荷方伤亡很少，甚至可能没有伤亡；英方无人伤亡。

en.s: The action of 21 July 1781 (French: Combat naval en vue de Louisbourg, or Combat naval à la hauteur de Louisbourg) was a naval skirmish off the harbour of Spanish River, Cape Breton, Nova Scotia (present-day Sydney, Nova Scotia), during the War of American Independence. Two light frigates of the French Navy, captained by Jean-François de Galaup, comte de Lapérouse and Louis-René Levassor de Latouche Tréville, engaged a convoy of 18 British ships and their Royal Navy escorts.

zh.s: 1781年7月21日海战（法语：Combat naval en vue de Louisbourg，或Combat naval à la hauteur de Louisbourg）是美国独立战争期间发生在新斯科舍省布雷顿角西班牙河港外的一场海上小规模交战，该地现为悉尼。法国海军的两艘轻型护卫舰分别由让-弗朗索瓦·德·加洛、拉佩鲁兹伯爵和路易-勒内·勒瓦索尔·德·拉图什·特雷维尔指挥，与一支由18艘英国船只组成的船队及其皇家海军护航舰艇交战。

en.s: The Battle of Parkumäki took place on July 21, 1789 during Gustav III's Russian War, Sweden won over the Russian Empire. During the time when the Russian general Ivan Ivanovich Michelson pulled his forces back, the Swedish commander Curt von Stedingk with about 1,300 men started his offensive against the remaining Russian general Schultz and his 1,000 soldiers whom stood by Parkumäki, and another 500 by Puiko. On July 21, Stedingk flanked and overwhelmed the both Russian positions and conquered their artillery. The Russians lost 200 men killed, 130 wounded and 500 captured during the fighting along with all their artillery, baggage and two standards lost to the Swedes, who suffered 186 men dead and wounded.

zh.s: 帕尔库迈基战役发生于1789年7月21日，是古斯塔夫三世俄瑞战争中的一场战斗，瑞典战胜俄罗斯帝国。当俄军将领伊万·伊万诺维奇·米赫尔松撤兵时，瑞典指挥官库尔特·冯·施泰丁克率约1,300人进攻俄军舒尔茨将军的部队：其中1,000人驻守帕尔库迈基，另有500人驻守普伊科。7月21日，施泰丁克从侧翼进攻，击溃了俄军两处阵地并缴获火炮。俄军在战斗中有200人阵亡、130人受伤、500人被俘，还损失了全部火炮、辎重和两面军旗；瑞典方面阵亡及受伤共186人。

It aimed to raise the whole of western France in revolt, bring an end to the French Revolution and restore the French monarchy.

en.s: The Battle of the Pyramids (French: Bataille des Pyramides), also known as the Battle of Embabeh (bataille d'Embabech), was fought on 21 July 1798 during the French invasion of Egypt and Syria. Occurring near the village of Embabeh, Ottoman Egypt, the battle was named by Napoleon after the distant Great Pyramid of Giza. After capturing Alexandria and advancing toward Cairo, Napoleon's army confronted Murad Bey's Mamluk-led forces.

zh.s: 金字塔战役（法语：Bataille des Pyramides）又称因巴贝战役（bataille d’Embabech），于1798年7月21日法国入侵埃及和叙利亚期间爆发。战斗发生在奥斯曼帝国治下埃及的因巴贝村附近。拿破仑以远处的吉萨大金字塔为这场战役命名。拿破仑的军队攻占亚历山大港并向开罗推进后，与穆拉德贝伊率领的马穆鲁克部队交战。

en.s: In the Battle of Castalla (21 July 1812) a small Spanish army commanded by Joseph O'Donnell advanced to attack an Imperial French division under the leadership of Jean Isidore Harispe. O'Donnell's battle plan was poorly conceived and the outnumbered French smashed his center column before his right and left wings could intervene. The engagement occurred during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 1812年7月21日，约瑟夫·奥唐奈率领一支规模不大的西班牙军队，向让·伊西多尔·阿里斯普指挥的法国帝国师发起进攻。奥唐奈的作战计划考虑不周，人数较少的法军趁西班牙军队的右翼和左翼尚未赶到之前击溃了其中路。这场战斗发生在半岛战争期间；半岛战争是拿破仑战争的一部分。

en.t: Inauguration of Leopold I of Belgium, first king of the Belgians
en.s: Leopold I (Leopold George Christian Frederick; 16 December 1790 – 10 December 1865) was the first king of the Belgians, reigning from 21 July 1831 until his death in 1865. The youngest son of Francis, Duke of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld, Leopold took a commission in the Imperial Russian Army and fought against Napoleon after French troops overran Saxe-Coburg during the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 利奥波德一世（利奥波德·乔治·克里斯蒂安·弗雷德里克；1790年12月16日—1865年12月10日）是比利时首任国王，自1831年7月21日起在位，直至1865年去世。他是萨克森-科堡-萨尔费尔德公爵弗朗茨最年幼的儿子。利奥波德曾加入俄罗斯帝国军队，并在拿破仑战争期间法军攻占萨克森-科堡后与拿破仑作战。

en.s: The Battle of Wisconsin Heights was the penultimate engagement of the 1832 Black Hawk War, fought between the United States state militia and allies, and the Sauk and Meskwaki tribes, led by Black Hawk. The battle took place in what is now Dane County, near present-day Sauk City, Wisconsin.

zh.s: 威斯康星高地战役是1832年黑鹰战争的倒数第二场交战，交战双方是美国州民兵及其盟友，以及由黑鹰率领的索克族和梅斯夸基族。战场位于现今威斯康星州戴恩县、靠近现今索克城的地方。

en.s: The Battle of Chinkiang was fought between British and Chinese forces in Chinkiang (Zhenjiang), Jiangsu province, China, on 21 July 1842 during the First Opium War. It was the last major battle of the war. The Chinese force consisted of a garrison of Manchu and Mongol Bannermen. In command of the British forces was Sir Hugh Gough. Leading one brigade was future British field marshal Sir Colin Campbell. The British capture of this stronghold allowed them to proceed to Nanking. Fought near the confluence of the Grand Canal and Yangtze River, the battle effectively blocked operation of the Caoyun system, a transport network vital for the movement of grain throughout the empire.

zh.s: 第一次鸦片战争期间，英军与清军于1842年7月21日在中国江苏省镇江交战。这是战争中的最后一场大型战役。清军由满洲和蒙古八旗驻军组成，英军由休·高夫爵士指挥，未来的英国陆军元帅科林·坎贝尔爵士率领其中一支旅。英军攻占镇江后得以继续进军南京。战斗发生在大运河与长江交汇处附近，实际上阻断了漕运系统的运行；这一运输网络对帝国各地的粮食运输至关重要。

en.s: The Battle(s) of Dargo or Dargo Campaign (Russian: Даргинский поход, romanized: Darginskiy pokhod) of 1845 was a series of military actions during the Murid War, the eastern phase of the Caucasus War of 1817–1864. During the campaign, Mikhail Vorontsov penetrated too deeply into enemy country, was surrounded, and partially fought his way out with heavy losses and was rescued by General R. K. Freitag.

en.s: The First Battle of Bull Run, also known as Battle of First Manassas (the name used by Confederate forces), was fought on July 21, 1861 in Prince William County, Virginia, near the city of Manassas, not far from Washington, D.C. It was the first major battle of the American Civil War. The Union's forces were slow in positioning themselves, allowing Confederate reinforcements time to arrive by rail. Each side had about 18,000 poorly trained and poorly led troops in their first battle. It was a Confederate victory, followed by a disorganized retreat of the Union forces.

zh.s: 第一次布尔溪战役又称第一次马纳萨斯战役（邦联军的称呼），发生于1861年7月21日，地点在弗吉尼亚州威廉王子县、马纳萨斯附近，距华盛顿特区不远。这是美国内战中的第一场大型战役。联邦军部署缓慢，使邦联军有时间通过铁路调来增援。双方各约有18,000名训练不足、指挥不力的士兵投入这场各自的首次大战。战役以邦联军获胜告终，联邦军随后溃乱撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Bezzecca was fought on 21 July 1866 between Italy and Austria during the Third Italian War of Independence. It was a victory of Italian volunteers, the Corpo Truppe Volontarie led by Giuseppe Garibaldi, against Austrian forces and occurred during an Italian invasion of Trentino (began in late June). The Austrians, commanded by Generalmajor Franz Kuhn von Kuhnenfeld consisted mainly of a mixture of locally-raised battalions and the elite Kaiserjäger light infantry.

zh.s: 意大利第三次独立战争期间，意大利与奥地利于1866年7月21日在贝泽卡交战。由朱塞佩·加里波第率领的意大利志愿军（Corpo Truppe Volontarie）战胜奥军。战役发生在意大利入侵特伦蒂诺期间，这场入侵始于6月下旬。奥军由弗朗茨·库恩·冯·库嫩费尔德少将指挥，主要由当地征募的营队和精锐的帝国猎兵轻步兵组成。

en.s: A by-election was held for the New South Wales Legislative Assembly electorate of Surry Hills on 21 July 1906 because of the resignation of John Norton (Independent). Norton blamed William Holman for an article in The Worker commenting on Norton's unnatural silence over the land scandals involving Paddy Crick and William Willis. Norton made a personal attack on Holman in parliament, challenging him to resign and both would contest Holman's seat of Cootamundra.

en.s: Alexander Fyodorovich Kerensky (4 May [O.S. 22 April] 1881 – 11 June 1970) was a Russian politician, lawyer and revolutionary who led the Russian Provisional Government and the short-lived Russian Republic for three months from late July to early November 1917 (N.S.). After the February Revolution of 1917, he joined the newly formed provisional government, first as Minister of Justice, then as Minister of War, and after July as the government's second Minister-Chairman.

zh.s: 亚历山大·费奥多罗维奇·克伦斯基（1881年5月4日〔旧历4月22日〕—1970年6月11日）是俄罗斯政治人物、律师和革命家，1917年7月下旬至11月上旬（新历）领导俄罗斯临时政府和短暂存在的俄罗斯共和国，任期三个月。1917年二月革命后，他加入新成立的临时政府，先后担任司法部长、陆军部长，并于7月后成为政府第二任部长会议主席。

en.s: The attack on Orleans was a naval and air action during World War I on 21 July 1918 when a German submarine fired on a small convoy of barges led by a tugboat off Orleans, Massachusetts, on the eastern coast of the Cape Cod peninsula. Several shells fired during the engagement likely missed their intended maritime or aircraft targets and fell to earth in the area around Orleans, giving the impression of a deliberate attack on the town.

zh.s: 1918年7月21日，第一次世界大战期间，一艘德国潜艇在马萨诸塞州奥尔良外海向一支由拖船领头的小型驳船船队开火，构成一次海上和空中军事行动。交战中发射的几枚炮弹可能没有击中原定的海上或飞机目标，而是落在奥尔良周边地区，因此看起来像是有人故意攻击该镇。

zh.s: “田纳西州诉约翰·托马斯·斯科普斯案”又称“斯科普斯猴子审判”，是美国的一起法律案件，审理时间为1925年7月10日至21日。高中教师约翰·T·斯科普斯被指违反田纳西州《巴特勒法案》；该法禁止在公立学校教授人类进化论。

en.s: The Central Committee of Anti-Fascist Militias of Catalonia (Catalan: Comitè Central de Milícies Antifeixistes de Catalunya, CCMA) was an administrative body created on 21 July 1936 by the president of the Government of Catalonia, Lluís Companys, under pressure by the anarcho-syndicalists of the National Confederation of Labor (CNT) and Iberian Anarchist Federation (FAI), which led the workers' struggle against the July 1936 military uprising in Barcelona.

zh.t: 西班牙内战：加泰罗尼亚反法西斯民兵中央委员会成立
zh.s: 加泰罗尼亚反法西斯民兵中央委员会（加泰罗尼亚语：Comitè Central de Milícies Antifeixistes de Catalunya，CCMA）是一个行政机构，由加泰罗尼亚政府主席路易斯·孔帕尼斯于1936年7月21日成立。当时，劳工全国联盟（CNT）和伊比利亚无政府主义者联合会（FAI）的无政府工团主义者施压，要求成立委员会；这两个组织领导了反对1936年7月巴塞罗那军事起义的工人斗争。委员会的成立也在加泰罗尼亚建立了无政府工团主义经济体制。

en.s: The 1952 Kern County earthquake occurred on July 21 in the southern San Joaquin Valley and measured 7.3 on the moment magnitude scale. The main shock occurred at 4:52 am Pacific Daylight Time (11:52 UTC), killed 12 people, injured hundreds more and caused an estimated $60 million in property damage. A small sector of damage near Bealville corresponded to a maximum Mercalli intensity of XI (Extreme), though this intensity rating was not representative of the majority of damage.

en.t: Sirimavo Bandaranaike (pictured) was sworn in as prime minister of Ceylon, becoming the world's first democratically elected female head of government
en.s: Sirima Ratwatte Dias Bandaranaike (née Ratwatte; 17 April 1916 – 10 October 2000), commonly known as Sirimavo Bandaranaike, was a Sri Lankan stateswoman who thrice served as Prime Minister of Sri Lanka from 1960 to 1965, from 1970 to 1977, and from 1994 to 2000. zh.s: 西丽玛·拉特瓦特·迪亚斯·班达拉奈克（原姓拉特瓦特；1916年4月17日—2000年10月10日），通常称西丽玛沃·班达拉奈克，是斯里兰卡政治家，曾三度担任斯里兰卡总理：1960年至1965年、1970年至1977年，以及1994年至2000年。她于1960年成为世界首位通过民主选举产生的女性总理。

en.s: The July 1978 Bolivian coup d'état was the military takeover of the Bolivian government by General Pereda and his supporters at the expense of the Banzer regime. en.t: Eastern Theatre of Eelam War IV
